description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Extended the Term of the Administrator Appointed to Nation Lanka Finance PLC
categorisation: The gazette content is a notice from the Central Bank of Sri Lanka regarding the extension of an Administrator's term for a finance company under the Banking (Special Provisions) Act. This constitutes a regulatory action based on specific legislation, falling squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5), which include statutory instruments, regulatory actions, and legal notices issued under established laws.
